integrity: The proof is analytic for all integers \(N\ge1\). Finite computation only cross-checks phase sums and asymptotics. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The witness uses commuting local dephasing and a mean-field Ising interaction. It proves class-wide exponent sharpness, not a universal lower bound for every model and not optimality of the upper-bound prefactor. The cosine-power spin expectation is known in one-axis-twisting theory; the claimed contribution is the exact faithful-state Umegaki formula with nonzero dephasing and its sharpness consequence.
title: Sharp \(N^{-1}\) entropy decay for a dephasing mean-field Ising witness
